line: Write down three things you're grateful for right now.
paragraph: A doorbell camera in Castle Rock, Colorado recorded a pizza delivery driver apologizing for mixing up an order. The driver was Suzanna Metcalf, who works as a full-time caregiver for others. Pastor Neal Seiwert saw the clip and shared it, and millions of people watched her humble kindness. Strangers who saw the video donated more than $76,000 to support her. She spends her days caring for others, and now others have cared for her.
